loyalty_coach_card_body: Here you see your total bonus balance and card holder name. You can pay orders using these bonuses.
loyalty_coach_cycle_body: Bonuses are calculated within specific cycles. Start and end dates of the cycle are shown here.
loyalty_coach_info_body: You earn bonuses for every purchase and can use them to pay for your next orders.
loyalty_coach_history_body: Here you can see all operations where bonuses were added or spent.
onboarding_1_title: Earn up to 10% cashback after every order with your Loyalty and Bonus cards. Use cashback on your next purchase!
onboarding_2_title: Invite a friend to the app and get a bonus between 3,000 and 5,000 ₩!
onboarding_3_title: We deliver orders across Korea within 1–2 business days and to Jeju islands within up to 3 business days!
help_delivery_free: Via our bot, promo codes are provided twice a week for free delivery. Apply the promo code to use the delivery service for free.
help_delivery_price_standard: Standard areas: each package (up to 20 kg) — 5,000 ₩
help_delivery_price_islands: Islands (including Jeju-do): each package (up to 20 kg) — 5,000 ₩
help_delivery_time_weekdays: Monday – Friday: orders placed before 16:00 are shipped the same day.
help_delivery_time_friday: Orders placed after 16:00 on Friday are shipped on Monday (arrive on Tuesday).
help_delivery_time_sunday: Orders placed after 14:00 on Sunday are shipped on the next business day.
help_delivery_arrival_islands: Delivery to islands: up to 1 week.
help_quality_main: Million Market pays special attention to ensuring product quality.
help_quality_delay_note: We are not fully responsible for delays during delivery caused by weather or logistics issues, but we do our best to support our customers.
help_quality_perishables_body: Special insulated boxes and ice packs in hot weather are used to ensure products arrive fresh and safe.
help_payments_body:
Million Market accepts the following payment types:
• Bank transfer – after payment, you must send the receipt photo to admins.
• BONUS CARD – you can pay using accumulated bonuses.
help_b2b_body: To become a wholesale merchant, fill in the wholesale request section in the Profile of the app. Our admins will contact you.
help_about_body: Million Market is a modern online trading platform in Korea. Through us you can find various products, buy at convenient and affordable prices, and use fast delivery.
help_paynet_status: PAYNET services are not available yet.
help_paynet_future: In the future, payments for services in Uzbekistan and fast, convenient transactions via PAYNET will be launched. Planned: CIS countries.
help_faq_phone_a: Yes, a phone number is required to place an order.
help_faq_support_a: Yes, you can contact the customer support section for any questions or issues.
help_faq_advantages_body:
• Honest and quality products
• Fast delivery
• Convenient payment system
• Premium service
help_faq_seller_a: Currently it is not possible to become a seller (will be added later).
help_faq_min_order_q: What is the minimum order amount?
help_faq_min_order_a: The minimum order amount depends on the type of product (1 kg / 1 piece / 1 box, etc.).
help_faq_issue_q: What if there is a problem with the order?
help_faq_issue_a: If there is a problem with the order, contact the customer support section — the issue will be resolved quickly.
help_contact_subtitle: Contact via phone, email and social networks
help_contact_text_1: The Million Market team serves all customers with the same care and attention. Every order is carefully packed and delivered with a focus on quality.
help_contact_text_2: Your trust is very important to us. During delivery, weather conditions on the way (for example, extreme heat) or high holiday load may slightly increase the waiting time.
help_contact_text_3: We strive to offer halal products to our customers with the best possible balance of fair price and high quality.
help_contact_text_signature: Every customer is valuable to us.\nWith respect, the Million Market team
